products.title: Scuderia Ferrari 2026 Team Charles Leclerc Cap - Red
products.description: Root for the Ferrari team and Charles LeClerc with this signature Trucker cap. Featuring Charles' number 16 on the brim topside and combining classic Ferrari red with a high-quality sewn-on team badge on the front crown, the classic trucker design provides ventilation on hot days, perfect for watching the race trackside in the sun. The structured crown and adjustable snap closure ensure you'll have the perfect fit every time.

products.title: Max Verstappen Red Bull Racing 2026 Orange Lion Helmet - 1:2 Model
products.description: A bold orange design for three iconic race weekends. The helmet Max Verstappen will wear during the 2026 Austrian, Belgian and Hungarian Grands Prix brings together high-impact colour, Red Bull Racing identity and the unmistakable Verstappen style. Created with exceptional attention to detail, this 1:2 scale replica of his racing helmet features an orange-tinted visor, internal padding and four stars representing his world championship victories. The vibrant orange finish is elevated by striking chrome details, contrasting dark blue elements and the lion emblem on top, making this a standout piece from Max's 2026 season. Whether displayed at home, in the office or as part of a growing Verstappen collection, this special edition helmet captures a memorable run of European race weekends in true Max style.

products.title: McLaren 2026 Team Lando Norris Driver Set Up T-Shirt - Papaya
products.description: Show your support for the McLaren F1 Team through 2026 with the official team apparel range from Puma. When Piastri and Norris climb into their cockpits for the next race in the calendar, make sure you're kitted out in style to cheer them on, whether you're trackside in person or watching from afar. The iconic colours and instantly recognisable team emblem will stand out wherever you are.
